Hi Marissa —

Thanks — this looks good. Rajesh (our Head of Infrastructure) and I should be on the call; please include our SRE lead (Alicia Park) and Infosec (I can pull in our security lead if you think that's useful). A few things to flag up front so the conversation is focused:

- We are planning an on-prem air-gapped pilot in Q2 that will have zero outbound internet egress from the inference cluster. All model updates must be pushed via approved media or a signed artifact registry.
- KMS must be a customer-managed key (HSM-backed) and keys cannot leave our HSM.
- Network will likely be isolated VLANs with a dedicated firewall; if we do cloud/VPC peering for any components we need clear egress rules.

Preferred times for us (ET):
- Tue Mar 2: 13:00–14:00 ET (this maps to your 10:00–11:00 PT)
